name: Nancy K. Smith
office: Palmdale School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 1

items.text: Nancy K. Smith is an incumbent Palmdale School District Governing Board member, elected in November 2013 and serving Trustee Area 1. She was the district's assistant superintendent for business from 1990 to 1993 and its superintendent from 1994 to 2003.

sentences.text: Nancy K. Smith is an incumbent Palmdale School District Governing Board member, elected in November 2013 and serving Trustee Area 1.
She was the district's assistant superintendent for business from 1990 to 1993 and its superintendent from 1994 to 2003.

items.text: As board president in 2018, Smith stated the board was not anti-charter when it voted to close a charter school over concerns about poor academic performance and questionable financial operations.
